verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהַי֙ אַתָּ֔ה אֲרֽוֹמִמְךָ֙ אוֹדֶ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֔ כִּ֥י עָשִׂ֖יתָ פֶּ֑לֶא עֵצ֥וֹת מֵֽרָח֖וֹק אֱמ֥וּנָה אֹֽמֶן׃
verses.literal: O LORD You are my God I will exalt You I will praise Your name For You have worked wonders plans formed long ago in perfect faithfulness . . .
verses.literalPt: Jeová, tu és o meu Deus; exaltar-te-ei e louvarei o teu nome, porque em fidelidade e verdade tens feito maravilhas, isto é, os teus antigos conselhos.

verses.original: כִּ֣י שַׂ֤מְתָּ מֵעִיר֙ לַגָּ֔ל קִרְיָ֥ה בְצוּרָ֖ה לְמַפֵּלָ֑ה אַרְמ֤וֹן זָרִים֙ מֵעִ֔יר לְעוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א יִבָּנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî śam·tā mê·‘îr lag·gāl qir·yāh ḇə·ṣū·rāh lə·map·pê·lāh ’ar·mō·wn zā·rîm mê·‘îr lə·‘ō·w·lām lō yib·bā·neh
verses.literal: Indeed You have made the city a heap of rubble the fortified town a ruin The fortress of strangers is a city no more it will never . . . be rebuilt
verses.literalPt: Pois da cidade fizeste um montão de pedras; da cidade fortificada uma ruína, do paço dos estranhos, que não seja mais cidade e que jamais seja reedificada.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֖ן יְכַבְּד֣וּךָ עַם־ עָ֑ז קִרְיַ֛ת גּוֹיִ֥ם עָרִיצִ֖ים יִירָאֽוּךָ׃
verses.literal: Therefore . . . a strong people will honor You The cities of ruthless nations will revere You
verses.literalPt: Por isso, te glorificarão povos ferozes, e te temerão cidades de nações formidáveis.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הָיִ֨יתָ מָע֥וֹז לַדָּ֛ל מָע֥וֹז לָאֶבְי֖וֹן בַּצַּר־ ל֑וֹ מַחְסֶ֤ה מִזֶּ֙רֶם֙ צֵ֣ל מֵחֹ֔רֶב כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ עָרִיצִ֖ים כְּזֶ֥רֶם קִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hā·yî·ṯā mā·‘ō·wz lad·dāl mā·‘ō·wz lā·’eḇ·yō·wn baṣ·ṣar- lōw maḥ·seh miz·ze·rem ṣêl mê·ḥō·reḇ kî rū·aḥ ‘ā·rî·ṣîm kə·ze·rem qîr
verses.literal: For You have been a refuge for the poor a stronghold for the needy in distress a refuge from the storm a shade from the heat For the breath of the ruthless is like rain against a wall
verses.literalPt: Porque te hás tornado fortaleza para o pobre, fortaleza para o necessitado na sua angústia, refúgio contra a tempestade, sombra contra o calor, quando o assopro dos violentos é como uma tempestade contra um muro.

verses.original: כְּחֹ֣רֶב בְּצָי֔וֹן שְׁא֥וֹן זָרִ֖ים תַּכְנִ֑יעַ חֹ֚רֶב בְּצֵ֣ל עָ֔ב זְמִ֥יר עָֽרִיצִ֖ים יַעֲנֶֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kə·ḥō·reḇ bə·ṣā·yō·wn šə·’ō·wn zā·rîm taḵ·nî·a‘ ḥō·reḇ bə·ṣêl ‘āḇ zə·mîr ‘ā·rî·ṣîm ya·‘ă·neh
verses.literal: like heat in a dry land You subdue the uproar of foreigners As the shade of a cloud cools the heat so the song of the ruthless is silenced
verses.literalPt: Como o calor em terra sedenta, abaterás o tumulto de estrangeiros; como o calor proveniente da sombra de nuvens, o cântico dos violentos será humilhado.

verses.original: וְעָשָׂה֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת לְכָל־ הָֽעַמִּים֙ בָּהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה מִשְׁתֵּ֥ה שְׁמָנִ֖ים מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה שְׁמָרִ֑ים שְׁמָנִים֙ מְמֻ֣חָיִ֔ם שְׁמָרִ֖ים מְזֻקָּקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ lə·ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm bā·hār haz·zeh miš·têh šə·mā·nîm miš·têh šə·mā·rîm šə·mā·nîm mə·mu·ḥā·yim šə·mā·rîm mə·zuq·qā·qîm
verses.literal: On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will prepare a lavish banquet for all the peoples a feast of aged wine of choice meat . . . of finely aged wine
verses.literalPt: Jeová do exércitos fará neste monte para todos os povos um banquete de coisas gordurosas, banquete de vinhos com fezes, de coisas gordurosas e ricas em tutano, de vinhos com fezes, depois de bem coados.

verses.original: וּבִלַּע֙ בָּהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה פְּנֵֽי־ הַלּ֥וֹט׀ הַלּ֖וֹט עַל־ כָּל־ הָֽעַמִּ֑ים וְהַמַּסֵּכָ֥ה הַנְּסוּכָ֖ה עַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇil·la‘ bā·hār haz·zeh pə·nê- hal·lō·wṭ hal·lō·wṭ ‘al- kāl- hā·‘am·mîm wə·ham·mas·sê·ḵāh han·nə·sū·ḵāh ‘al- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: On this . . . mountain He will swallow up the shroud that enfolds . . . all peoples the sheet that covers . . . all nations
verses.literalPt: Aniquilará neste monte a coberta que cobre todos os povos e o véu que está posto sobre todas as nações.

verses.original: בִּלַּ֤ע הַמָּ֙וֶת֙ לָנֶ֔צַח וּמָחָ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה דִּמְעָ֖ה מֵעַ֣ל כָּל־ פָּנִ֑ים וְחֶרְפַּ֣ת עַמּ֗וֹ יָסִיר֙ מֵעַ֣ל כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: bil·la‘ ham·mā·weṯ lā·ne·ṣaḥ ū·mā·ḥāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh dim·‘āh mê·‘al kāl- pā·nîm wə·ḥer·paṯ ‘am·mōw yā·sîr mê·‘al kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ kî Yah·weh dib·bêr
verses.literal: He will swallow up death forever The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face and remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth For the LORD has spoken
verses.literalPt: Aniquilará a morte para sempre; enxugará Deus as lágrimas de todos os rostos; e tirará de cima da terra todo o opróbrio do seu povo. Pois Jeová o disse.

verses.original: וְאָמַר֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא הִנֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ זֶ֛ה קִוִּ֥ינוּ ל֖וֹ וְיֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נוּ זֶ֤ה יְהוָה֙ קִוִּ֣ינוּ ל֔וֹ נָגִ֥ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֖ה בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar bay·yō·wm ha·hū hin·nêh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū zeh qiw·wî·nū lōw wə·yō·wō·šî·‘ê·nū zeh Yah·weh qiw·wî·nū lōw nā·ḡî·lāh wə·niś·mə·ḥāh bî·šū·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: And in that day it will be said Surely this is our God we have waited for Him and He has saved us This is the LORD for whom we have waited Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation
verses.literalPt: Dir-se-á, naquele dia: Eis que este é o nosso Deus; por ele temos esperado, e ele nos salvará. Este é Jeová; por ele temos esperado; exultaremos e nos regozijaremos na salvação que ele der.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תָנ֥וּחַ יַד־ יְהוָ֖ה בָּהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְנָ֤דוֹשׁ מוֹאָב֙ תַּחְתָּ֔יו כְּהִדּ֥וּשׁ מַתְבֵּ֖ן בְּמֵי מַדְמֵנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯā·nū·aḥ yaḏ- Yah·weh bā·hār haz·zeh wə·nā·ḏō·wōš mō·w·’āḇ taḥ·tāw kə·hid·dūš maṯ·bên bə·mē maḏ·mê·nāh
verses.literal: For the hand of the LORD will rest on this mountain But Moab will be trampled in his place as straw . . . is trodden into the dung pile
verses.literalPt: Pois neste monte repousará a mão de Jeová, e Moabe será trilhado no seu lugar, assim como se trilha a palha na água do monturo.

verses.original: וּפֵרַ֤שׂ יָדָיו֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְפָרֵ֥שׂ הַשֹּׂחֶ֖ה לִשְׂח֑וֹת וְהִשְׁפִּיל֙ גַּֽאֲוָת֔וֹ עִ֖ם אָרְבּ֥וֹת יָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ê·raś yā·ḏāw bə·qir·bōw ka·’ă·šer yə·p̄ā·rêś haś·śō·ḥeh liś·ḥō·wṯ wə·hiš·pîl ga·’ă·wā·ṯōw ‘im ’ā·rə·bō·wṯ yā·ḏāw
verses.literal: He will spread out his hands within it as a swimmer spreads his arms to swim His pride will be brought low despite the skill of his hands
verses.literalPt: Estenderá as suas mãos no meio deles, assim como as estende o nadador para nadar, e abater-lhe-á sua altivez juntamente com as ciladas das suas mãos.

verses.original: וּמִבְצַ֞ר מִשְׂגַּ֣ב חוֹמֹתֶ֗יךָ הֵשַׁ֥ח הִשְׁפִּ֛יל הִגִּ֥יעַ לָאָ֖רֶץ עַד־ עָפָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·miḇ·ṣar miś·gaḇ ḥō·w·mō·ṯe·ḵā hê·šaḥ hiš·pîl hig·gî·a‘ lā·’ā·reṣ ‘aḏ- ‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: The high-walled . . . fortress will be brought down . . . cast to the ground into the dust
verses.literalPt: As fortificações das tuas altas muralhas, ele as demolirá, abaterá e fará dar em terra, reduzindo-as a pó.
